versions.changelog:
**Summary:** Heartbeat process and workspace file management expanded and clarified; new rules enforce robust, low-cost, and minimal-risk heartbeat checks.

Updated to work with the Openclaw Projects and Build a dev team skills more cohesively   |   https://clawhub.ai/encryptshawn/openclaw-projects   |  https://clawhub.ai/encryptshawn/build-dev-team

- Heartbeat sessions now use a dedicated, cheapest-available model (not the PM agent's primary model); OpenRouter minimax model preferred if configured.
- Heartbeat logic strictly references a pre-recorded HEARTBEAT.md for Asana project and section GIDs, eliminating in-session discovery or browsing.
- Workspace file set expanded: now expects USER.md, TOOLS.md, HEARTBEAT.md, and AGENTS.md (all read-only, credentials never stored).
- Heartbeat process must fail fast and never escalate or retry on failure; failure stops the session without workflow loops.
- Minor format and protocol clarifications for multi-project management, session communication, and dependency skill installation instructions.

**Credential trust and dependency skill clarifications added. No functional workflow changes.**

- Clarifies that this skill never accesses or requests credentials or secrets; all API actions (Asana, email) are delegated to separately installed dependency skills.
- Credential env var names are now explicitly documented as labels for dependency skills, not secrets seen by this skill.
- Clarifies that heartbeat scheduling and session invocation is managed externally by the OpenClaw platform.
- Reorganized documentation to separate credential trust model, dependency skills, and workflow responsibilities.
- No changes to the project management or requirements workflows.

Version 1.0.1 — Adds automated Asana heartbeat/queue checks and clarifies Asana board protocols.

- Added support for handling the Asana heartbeat queue: checks PM Queue and task status every 30 minutes, nudges agents when action is needed.
- Updated workflows and documentation for project-dedicated operation and required Asana/E-mail env vars.
- Clarified protocol for sending sessions_send nudges, with required inclusion of Asana GID, task name, and URL.
- Explicitly documented allowed agent communication routes and Asana board column structure.
- No changes to direct engineering/coding or Asana API handling.

dev-project-manager 1.0.0

- Initial release of a comprehensive AI Project Manager skill for software development.
- Supports client engagement, requirements elicitation, SRS creation/updating, impact classification, effort/cost estimation, scope/change management, project board/task management via Asana (excluding direct Asana API calls, you need to install a good Asana skill for this globally for all your agents to use), and coordination between clients and engineering agents.
- Provides structured communication protocols and decision frameworks, adapting messaging style for clients and engineers.
- Handles UI mockup/request processing, implementation plan review, and client status updates.
- Does not manage direct engineering/coding tasks or Asana API integration.
